reason: I'd grab the free tricks and play with them, but 99 ₪ for an app is more than I ever pay for software. The free ones would probably be enough to show a few friends.
objection: 99 ₪ is a lot for an app, most apps are free or cost a few shekels, and it's installed from a browser instead of the App Store so I'm not sure how solid it is.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks blew me and my friends away and the full version was around 30 ₪, I might pay once.
